open_questions: Story designer: add ids SS_BTN_CLOSE (Close) and SS_LBL_CAPACITY (Capacity: %d per commodity). SS_POST_NAME is used with a fallback. Code uses fallbacks until then.
handoff: A click on a station or its marker now opens a centred Space Storage panel for that system: title, system name, capacity line, one RatingBar row per commodity, Close button (Esc also closes). Without a post it posts the locked reason instead. It refreshes at cycle end and closes when a planet is clicked. The route/destination pick guard is kept. Tests: 622 pass, 0 fail. Not checked by eye: panel layout, position, overlap with other panels. Git not used.

details.how_to_see: Learn A1, click the station in a system with a post.
